gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: Looking back ___ it, the risk was worth taking.
gaps.explanation: look back ON something = remember and think about the past.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
